entities.name: Zbyněk Hráček
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zbyněk Hráček is a Czech chess grandmaster. He was Czech Chess Champion in 1994, won the Zonal tournament Odorhea 1995 and the tournaments Pardubice (Open) 1993, Altensteig 1995 and Lippstadt 2000.
